description: Landing-page studio: remove all DeepSeek/Gemini wording and the provider dropdown, point generation at the new /api/generate-content route with kind=landing, polish the studio UI/CSS, and make README wording generic. Depends on FEAT-001 (the /api/generate-content route and the provider-neutral lib must already exist). Note: FEAT-001 renames the route folder, so until this feature updates the fetch URL the studio's runtime call is stale — build stays green because the URL is a string, but this feature must update it.
steps: In src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx: delete the `provider` useState and the AI-model <select> (#aiProvider) entirely. Stop appending `provider` to the FormData; append `kind` = 'landing' instead. Change the fetch target from '/api/generate-landing-page' to '/api/generate-content'. The reference-media file input accept becomes 'image/*' (drop video) with a small <small> note that videos are not used by the AI. Replace all provider-conditional copy with generic text: sub-panel description 'Upload photos, describe the page, and let AI draft the HTML.', and the Generate button label 'Generate with AI' / 'Generating…' (disabled while aiLoading). No string 'Gemini' or 'DeepSeek' may remain in the file.

Preserve ALL existing functionality while reformatting the heavily-minified single-line JSX into readable multi-line JSX: name input, urlSlug slug-input, the controlled htmlContent textarea (name='htmlContent', manual editing), setHtml(data.html) + setTab('preview') on success, inline aiError rendered via <div className='auth-message error'>, removable file chips (.ai-files with X button), the createLandingPage submit via the form action import from ../actions, the studio-safety privacy note, Cancel/Save actions, the code/preview tabs, and the preview iframe with sandbox="" (DO NOT remove or weaken sandbox="").

Polish styles in src/app/globals.css. Target the '/* Landing-page studio */' block (around lines 353-355) and keep the two responsive @media rules working: @media (max-width:1050px) around line 400 narrows the settings column, and @media (max-width:760px) around line 419 stacks .landing-studio to a single column (.landing-settings loses right border, gains bottom border). Improvements: clearer visual hierarchy/spacing in .landing-settings; make .landing-ai an inviting visually-distinct card (subtle accent background/border, more padding); readable file chips (.ai-files li); obvious .ai-generate loading/disabled state; obvious active tab state in .editor-tabs button.active; bump the very small font sizes (8-10px) to readable values (>=11-12px) across .landing-ai-title, .studio-safety, .editor-tabs. Keep the semantic class approach (.landing-*, .studio-*, .field, .button primary/secondary) — NO Tailwind utility classes. Keep .dark overrides coherent.

Update README.md for generic wording: change the 'AI Landing-page Generator' feature bullet to not name Gemini; describe the provider generically as 'the AI provider (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio)'. In the env section remove the GEMINI_API_KEY line and the two-provider dropdown note; keep DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL, DEEPSEEK_MODEL documented accurately (names unchanged). Mention that the email-template builder also offers AI generation. DO NOT touch the .env file.
acceptance_criteria: src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx contains no 'Gemini' or 'DeepSeek' string, no provider state, no model <select>; it POSTs to /api/generate-content with kind=landing and a Generate-with-AI button; the sandbox="" preview iframe and createLandingPage save flow are intact.
The studio JSX is formatted as readable multi-line JSX (no mega single-line elements).
README.md has no 'Gemini'/'GEMINI_API_KEY' references and documents the DASHSCOPE_*/DEEPSEEK_MODEL vars with generic AI-provider wording.
The @media (max-width:760px) rule still collapses .landing-studio to one column.
`npm run build` passes and `npm run lint` passes.
verification: Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`; confirm both pass.
Run `rg -n "Gemini|GEMINI_API_KEY" README.md` and confirm no matches.
findings: DONE. src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx: removed the `provider` useState and the #aiProvider model <select> entirely; handleGenerate now POSTs to '/api/generate-content' and appends form field `kind`='landing' (no `provider` field). Reference-media file input accept is now 'image/*' only with a <small> note that videos are not used by the AI. All provider-conditional copy replaced with generic wording: AI-generator description 'Upload photos, describe the page, and let AI draft the HTML.' and the button label is 'Generate with AI' / 'Generating…' (disabled while aiLoading). No 'Gemini'/'DeepSeek'/'provider'/'generate-landing-page' string remains in the file. The heavily-minified single-line JSX was reformatted into readable multi-line JSX with ALL functionality preserved: name input, urlSlug slug-input (pattern [a-zA-Z0-9-]+), controlled htmlContent textarea, setHtml(data.html)+setTab('preview') on success, aiError + submit error via <div className='auth-message error'>, removable .ai-files chips with X button, createLandingPage submit via ../actions, the .studio-safety privacy note, Cancel/Save actions, code/preview tabs, and the preview iframe kept sandbox="" (unchanged). CSS (src/app/globals.css '/* Landing-page studio */' block): clearer hierarchy/spacing in .landing-settings (settings column widened to 330px, flex column so .studio-actions pin to bottom via margin-top:auto); .landing-ai is now an inviting card (subtle green gradient bg + #bfeed7 border + soft shadow + filled accent icon); .ai-files li chips readable on white w/ border and hover-delete; .ai-generate keeps obvious disabled/wait state; .editor-tabs button.active has distinct bg+inset ring and a hover state; bumped former 7-10px font sizes to >=11-12px across .landing-ai-title, .studio-safety, .editor-tabs, .studio-code, slug prefix, file input/small notes. Added coherent .dark overrides for .landing-ai, .studio-safety, .ai-files li, .slug-input span. Both responsive breakpoints preserved: @media(max-width:1050px) narrows .landing-studio settings column, @media(max-width:760px) stacks .landing-studio to one column with .landing-settings losing right border and gaining bottom border. README.md: AI Landing-page Generator bullet reworded to name the provider generically ('the AI provider (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio)'), added an AI Email Templates bullet; env section removed GEMINI_API_KEY and the two-provider dropdown note while keeping DASHSCOPE_API_KEY/DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL/DEEPSEEK_MODEL documented (names unchanged). .env file untouched. Verification: `npm run build` PASS (route tree shows /api/generate-content), `npm run lint` PASS; grep for 'Gemini|DeepSeek|provider|generate-landing-page' in the create page returns nothing and 'Gemini|GEMINI_API_KEY' in README returns nothing. Note: ripgrep (rg) is not installed in this environment; used the equivalent grep/search tooling to run the same invariant checks.
